decisions.reason: As a 2023 launch close to the core offer that remained prominent on the home page through 2024, it appears strategically aligned and still worth backing as a low-uncertainty extension of the established QA portfolio.

This oncology risk management software builds directly on the firm's integrated QA and automation capabilities, and after only two years in a slow-adoption clinical market there is still enough upside and unresolved uncertainty to justify keeping the option open.

The CT image quality test phantom fits the firm's medical imaging QA direction and was launched only in 2024, so the market signal is still too early to abandon an adjacent product with clear capability overlap.

Although more distant from the historical offer, the mammography image quality phantom is a 2024 adjacency in imaging QA and its option value remains positive because learning is still limited and the carrying cost is likely modest relative to potential strategic expansion.

The full field mammography test phantom is also an early-stage 2024 adjacent product, and for an expanding R&D-intensive firm it is too soon to conclude that this niche imaging option will not pay off.

Medical imaging quality assurance instruments are closely connected to the firm's measurement, calibration and support strengths, and after a 2024 launch the prudent real-options choice is to retain the product while demand uncertainty resolves.
